div.h2: Built by operators, for ambitious UAE businesses
div.p: SGC Tech AI was founded on a single observation: mid-market businesses in the UAE were stuck with spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and disconnected tools while waiting months for ERP implementations that never quite delivered.

Our founders have personally sat in finance, sales, and operations chairs — leading Odoo deployments across real-estate developers, brokerages, and contractors that have collectively processed AED 1.15 billion in sales volume across real-estate brokerages and developers. That practitioner perspective shapes every engagement we take on.

Incorporated as Scholarix Global Consultant FZE in the IFZA Dubai Free Zone, we deliver fixed-price, fixed-timeline implementations — with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, ESR, PDPL, and RERA compliance built in from the first line of config.
The principles that drive every package we build and every client we serve.

Give UAE mid-market operators a single, integrated Odoo + AI operating system — delivered on a fixed price, fixed timeline — that replaces spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, Tally, and disconnected tools for good.

Become the reference Odoo + AI implementation partner for UAE real-estate brokerages, developers, and contractors navigating Dubai Law No. 7 of 2025, RERA/Ejari tightening, UAE Corporate Tax, and PDPL — with 30–50 retained mid-market clients across UAE/GCC.

Provable over promised — every claim is tied to an audited number or named project. Operator empathy — we've sat in the finance and ops chairs ourselves. Compliance-first — UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, ESR, UBO, goAML, PDPL, RERA, TDRA built into delivery. Fixed price, fixed timeline — no open-ended retainers.

div.h2: From operator roots to enterprise solutions
div.p: Founded in 2024 — built on years of hands-on UAE ERP delivery experience.

Over four years of hands-on Odoo implementations across UAE real-estate brokerages, developers, and group holdings — including Samana Group, Peace Homes, AX Capital, and the flagship OSUS rollout (580 deals, AED 1.15B volume). AI-powered document extraction, inbound voice, and AML/PEP screening capabilities built and deployed.

Incorporated as Scholarix Global Consultant FZE in IFZA Dubai Free Zone. Formalised three-layer pricing model: Implementation, Platform Subscription, Operations Retainer. Odoo v17–v19 capability stack with AI layer production-ready.

Independently audited 104% Year-1 ROI and 5.9-month payback validated. Rescue audit service launched. Odoo v20-ready architecture. Odoo Partner enrolment active. Targeting 30–50 retained mid-market clients across UAE/GCC.
Every engagement listed below is a founder-led, hands-on Odoo implementation — not a consulting deck, not a whitepaper, not a hypothetical.

Odoo operations implementation — property listings, agent management, and transaction processing across brokerage operations.

div.h2: Status quo costs more than transformation
div.p: Conservative annual estimate for a 25-agent UAE brokerage. Your numbers may differ — we model them in Discovery.
4–7 day calculation cycle, agent disputes, 1.5 FTEs of finance time absorbed monthly — costing an estimated AED 180K/yr in wasted labour.
WhatsApp leads not logged, no follow-up cadence, ~15% conversion left on the table — an estimated AED 420K/yr in missed revenue.
Quarterly RERA/VAT/CT reporting rebuilt manually, audit stress and error risk — an estimated AED 60K/yr in compliance overhead.
SPA, Ejari, MOU, passport scans re-keyed at ~8 hours per deal — an estimated AED 90K/yr in manual labour.
Total cost of doing nothing: AED 750,000 / year. The question isn't "can we afford a system?" — it's "can we afford another year without one?"
Every engagement follows a structured, milestone-based process — no ambiguity, no scope creep.
30-minute call to confirm fit and ICP match. No commitment required. We assess your vertical, team size, and compliance needs.
2-week paid diagnostic with a written remediation plan. 50% credited to implementation if you proceed within 90 days. From AED 5,000.
Fixed price, fixed timeline, defined go-live date and acceptance criteria. Discovery to go-live in 2–16 weeks depending on tier.
Monthly ownership post-go-live with quarterly ROI reporting modelled on the OSUS audit template. Bronze (AED 5K/mo), Silver (AED 9K/mo), or Gold (AED 15K/mo). 6-month minimum.

Fixed-price, fixed-timeline Odoo + AI implementation. Go-live guarantee: if we miss the agreed go-live date by more than 14 days for reasons within our control, one month of Operations Retainer is free.

50% of audit fee credited if you proceed to Implementation within 90 days.

div.h4: Is the implementation price a one-time fee?
div.p: Yes — the implementation price is a one-time fixed fee. In addition, a mandatory monthly platform subscription covers hosting, AI credits, UAE compliance updates, and SLA. The optional operations retainer covers ongoing enhancements.

div.h4: Does the price include Odoo licencing?
div.p: SGC TECH AI packages contain community or LGPL-licenced modules. Odoo Enterprise edition is licensed separately from Odoo S.A. and is not included in our package price.

We target a go-live window of 30–90 business days from project kick-off, depending on package scope and complexity. Our structured 6-phase process keeps every engagement on schedule with clear milestones throughout.
If we miss the agreed go-live date by 14 or more days, your next month's platform subscription is free. No fine print, no excuses.

div.h4: Is UAE VAT included in the prices shown?
div.p: All prices on this page are exclusive of 5% UAE VAT. VAT will be applied at checkout and shown separately on your tax invoice. We are a UAE VAT-registered entity.

div.h4: Do you offer custom enterprise quotes?
div.p: Absolutely. For large enterprises, multi-site deployments, or heavily customised requirements, contact us at renbran@sgctech.ai for a tailored proposal.
